memo.headline: The application is marked inconsistent due to claimed sales exceeding plausible margins relative to supplier receipts and low digital transaction coverage.

character.text: The food stall has operated for 3 years in Bandung. While daily entries are maintained across multiple pages, recorded sales are 5.6× of supplier purchases, which deviates from expected food stall margins. Additionally, QRIS records substantiate only 13% of claimed sales, leaving significant unverified cash volume.

capacity.text: On hard evidence alone, monthly inflow is Rp 6.028.500, whereas total claimed revenue reaches Rp 45.850.000, yielding a net cash flow of Rp 35.800.000 on the high end. Monthly supplier receipts average Rp 8.250.000, against total costs of Rp 10.050.000. Policy suggests no maximum instalment because the sources contradict each other, which leaves the requested instalment of Rp 2.216.031 unvalidated by hard verification.

capital.text: The business regularly repurchases staple inventory such as rice, chicken, and produce across weekly receipts from local merchants. However, shop photos are missing from the file, so existing physical assets and stock on hand cannot be visually confirmed. Recorded cash purchases show repeated weekly reinvestment averaging Rp 8.250.000.

collateral.text: The requested financing of Rp 50.000.000 falls well within the KUR collateral-free threshold of Rp 100.000.000, meaning additional collateral may not be mandated by program rules. No physical collateral assets are documented or visible in the file. The loan assessment consequently depends primarily on verifiable business cash flow.

conditions.text: The borrower seeks Rp 50.000.000 over a tenor of 24 months to support food stall operations. The enterprise serves local eatery clientele in Bandung, maintaining steady customer traffic with recorded transactions throughout the month. Economic performance depends on food commodity prices, as shown by regular purchases of staples like chili, chicken, and rice.

officerNextSteps: Conduct an on-site visit to inspect the physical warung, verify seating capacity, and capture shop photos.
Cross-check cash sales directly via an interview to establish the actual cash-to-QRIS payment ratio.
Review additional supplier purchase receipts to confirm whether inventory purchases match the claimed sales volume.

ownerSummary.verified: Catatan buku harian Anda rapi dan transaksi masuk lewat QRIS serta nota belanja bahan pokok dari pasar/agen sudah terdata dengan baik.
ownerSummary.missing: Foto tempat usaha dan konfirmasi penerimaan uang tunai harian belum lengkap di dalam berkas.
tips: Minta dan simpan semua nota belanja bahan dari pasar atau agen secara lengkap setiap kali kulakan.
Ajak lebih banyak pelanggan membayar dengan QRIS agar perputaran omzet tercatat rapi secara digital.
Siapkan foto tempat usaha, dapur, dan etalase makanan saat petugas bank datang berkunjung.
